rubric_content.text_property: The reply does NOT express continued interest in the specific role that was declined, and does not ask about next steps for that role.

rubrics.description: This is the exact regression the case exists to catch: root_agent previously fabricated an intent of continued interest for a rejection email, producing a reply saying 'I remain very interested in this opportunity'. final_response_match_v2 scored that buggy reply as a 1.0 similarity match against the correct reference, so this rubric is the one that actually catches it.

rubric_content.text_property: The reply acknowledges the rejection outcome rather than treating the email as neutral or positive correspondence.

rubrics.description: Guards against the reply reading as if the email were a generic status update instead of a decline.

rubric_content.text_property: The reply is a gracious, professional acknowledgement appropriate to a rejection.

rubrics.description: Checks overall tone independent of the specific continued-interest regression above.
